narrativeActions.action: Stands beside her travel suitcase after leaving the taxi and looks toward Villa Serena with restrained fatigue and cautious interest.

location: Villa Serena old coastal gate approach, low stone wall, white shutters, Mediterranean morning light.

desktop.composition: Independent wide cinematic exterior: use horizontal space for the gate, wall, coastal view and taxi approach; Nika and suitcase occupy a readable third with open landscape/architecture supporting the arrival beat and lower dialogue-safe value area.
desktop.framing: Natural eye-level lens, no portrait crop or blurred side fill; face, hands, suitcase, feet/contact shadow, gate and important architecture remain visible at 1366x768, 1600x900, 1920x900 and 1920x1080.

portrait.composition: The existing approved mobile composition remains authoritative for 360x640, 390x844 and 430x932.
portrait.framing: Do not alter the mobile source.

qualityAcceptance: Landscape is a standalone arrival composition, not a stretched portrait.
sceneContinuity: The opening arrival establishes the villa gate and morning setting before the next beat introduces Matteo at the same gate; keep the coastal hotel architecture continuous.
